title: derris ornithocephala
intro: Derris ornithocephala, commonly known as a species of legume, is a plant native to tropical Africa. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include treating fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Derris ornithocephala are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antiseptic properties, which help to soothe pain and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
